question: Related Questions Q. I have recently completed agricultural engineering and i am getting an job as an engineer in rural bank owned by Government of India.Rural banks are the agencies through which money gets distributed for lifting the socio economic conditions of rural areas.They employ various professionals like vetenary doctrs, agriculture graduates etc etc...Is it permissible to do this job. 1591 views Q. I want to know 1- How to calculate Zakat on CPF( Central Provident Fund),CPF is like Employee Provident Fund.In CPF amount will be deposited from Employee salary deduction and company contribution. And CPF will be given at the time of retirement a) I understand Zakat is payable when we possess the money, Shall we calculate the zakat for all those year when money was getting deposited or for the year when we get the money ?? 2- How to calculate Zakat on Insurance Policies which will get mature in 25 years time (if I withdraw from policy no return will be given.)?Shall we pay zakat for every annual premium or only for the year when we get the money ? 3- How to calculate Zakat for Life Time policy( In life time policy fund will be invested in market and value can increase and decrease depending on market conditions), maturity date is after 25 years.This type of Policy has some surrender value if I want to withdraw from the policy. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 31295 Country: India Title: We have a complex, which consists of 13 rooms, My question is 1.can we open a lodge in it, Question: We have a complex, which consists of 13 rooms, My question is 1.can we open a lodge in it, 2.Should the requirement like television should be provided to the customer. Answer ID: 31295 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 567/567/M=1432) If by lodge you mean only room on rent such as guest house etc, then there is no problem in opening a lodge. But it is not correct to provide TV facility to the customers. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
